text: BiTRONICS M870 - Legacy | GE Vernova | Electrification
GE Vernova’s Electrification has discontinued sales of this product. Please contact us to discuss alternatives.
heading: Detached Display Unit

text: The M870D provides Mx7x users the option of a local or remote indication of measured or calculated parameters. Used alongside GE Vernova Grid's Mx7x IEDs, the M870D is a cost-effective and reliable solution for providing an indication of measured or calculated parameters.
heading: Detached Display Unit

text: The M870D comes in a rugged aluminium 4-inch round case and uses efficient, long-lasting, highly reliable LEDs for display. It provides high-resolution, three-line simultaneous display and five significant digits per line. In addition, pre-set engineering units or customised text is automatically displayed.
heading: Robust, reliable, high definition

text: Buttons enable scrolling to the desired parameter, or can be set for continuous parameter looping. A DB9 pass-through front port allows direct hook-up to Mx7x IEDs from the front of the display for easy configuration and file download.
